title: Everyday Singapore Apps & Digital Services
editorialPolicy: Curated on 11 October 2026. A first-party publisher link identifies where to check an app; it does not mean the app listing, supported OS version, fees or eligibility were revalidated independently. Exact store URLs are included only when specifically identified. No paid placements or account data collected.
serviceDistinction: Web-only services are not apps and display Open official service, not Download.
